summary: workflow archive, workflow status, sync and the cached-pricing reader all use data.db; an upgrade that only has the archive.db from earlier releases moves it (with WAL/SHM sidecars) to data.db.
reason: Earlier releases archived into archive.db while sync wrote data.db. Defaulting to data.db without a move made status look empty after upgrade; reading archive.db while sync wrote data.db split the data. One store with a one-time move fixes both.
validated_outcome: TestArchiveDBPathMigratesLegacyArchive covers the move and the both-present case.
